tasks.gr9-atoms-elements-compounds-t2: Topic: Atoms, Elements and Compounds. Cover atomic structure (protons, neutrons, electrons), elements, compounds, mixtures, periodic table, and chemical symbols. Ask learners to identify atom parts, distinguish element vs compound vs mixture, interpret chemical symbols, or explain how elements combine to form compounds.
tasks.gr9-chemical-reactions-acids-bases-t2: Topic: Chemical Reactions, Acids, Bases and Salts. Cover reactants and products, signs of reactions, pH, acids, bases, neutralisation, and conservation of mass. Ask learners to identify reaction signs, classify substances by pH, explain neutralisation, or apply the law of conservation of mass.
